title: Akbar Yu Na Jao Chodkar
body:
Akbar yu na jaao chodkar
Kehte the shabbir ro rokar
Baad tere ab haale dil my kisko sunaaunga
Tere bin ek pal bhi mai raahat na paaunga
Chal rahi hai qalb par qanjar…..
Saare sahaare lutgaye tanha hu  noore ain
Ibne ameer hoke ghareeb aaj hai Hussain
Reham kardo meri aseeri par….
Tum mere aankhon ki thandak zindagaani ho
Kaise jaane du mere nana ki nishaani ho
Ab na nazar aayenge paigamber….
Sehnahi paaunga Akbar mai ye judaai
Saath tumhaare jaayegi baba ki beenaayi
Thokare khaaunga noore nazar…
Ye to bataake jaao mai laila se kya kahu
Daag dil per deke na jaao maa se kya kahu
Marjaayegi laila ghutghutkar…
Jisne tumhe beton ke baraabar paala tha Akbar
Kaise jaaoge use ab tanha chodkar
Aarzue zainabe muztar…..
Raah tumhara dekh rahi hai sughra watan me
Byaah ka Armaan basaa baithi hai wo man me
Yu na jaao Armaan todkar….
Jung ke liye tayar karke kadiyal jawaa ko
Choomkar peshaani bhej rahe hai maidaa ko
Kehte the seene se lagaakar….
Mai bhi tumhaare peeche peeche aaunga beta
Phir na kabhi tasweer tumhaari paaunga beta
Dekhte rehna baap ko mud mudkar…..
Chalpade Akbar to peeche the Sarwar althaf
Mai na bayaa karpaaunga ab wo manzar althaf
Goonji sada har ek thokar par…..
